subject_transport.global_freshness_rule: Every row has a globally unique returned subagent invocation identity and a globally unique predeclared dispatch nonce.
subject_transport.once_only_fuse: The row becomes permanently attempted when spawn is submitted. A failed spawn, crash, missing output, malformed output, prohibited activity, controller loss, or ambiguous terminal can never be relaunched.
subject_transport.initial_message_rule: The initial message contains only the fixed minimal transport instruction followed byte-for-byte by the frozen provider-visible test packet. subject_transport.minimal_transport_instruction_utf8: TEST-TAKER TRANSPORT: Answer the frozen packet below directly in your first final response. Do not use tools, files, browsing, network, memory, delegation, or other agents.
subject_transport.prohibited_activity_disposition: Preserve the first attempt and classify under the frozen FAIL or controller-invalid boundary; never retry.
